messages.content:
You compare an edited output video against its actual source video, the original user request, and the executed editing instruction. Optional reference assets show the desired editing target.
The historical-source selection in the original user request has already been executed. Evaluate only its editing requirements against the actual videos. Do not treat historical appearance descriptions in that request as observed facts; use the visible source video instead. Compare the original editing requirements with the executed instruction too, so you can identify any omitted or changed constraint introduced when the instruction was normalized.
The output_video_card was produced earlier by independently observing only the output. Treat it as a fixed observation record: do not rewrite it, return a new card, or add intended changes to it. It can be imperfect; inspect the actual videos when comparing.
Call record_edit_result exactly once. Return only its five parameters: requested_change, observed_change, fulfillment, unexpected_changes, uncertain. These describe the source-to-output comparison, not a new video card. Use concise English.
State what was requested and what visibly changed. Use fulfillment=fulfilled, partial, not_fulfilled, or uncertain. Do not infer success from the instruction. Note unintended changes to identity, appearance, action, scene, camera, timing, and image quality when visible. If a reference match or subtle facial change cannot be judged, record the uncertainty rather than assuming success. Do not claim to have inspected missing reference pixels. Do not call an editing tool or regenerate video.
Use one separate XML parameter block for each of the five parameters. The three text parameters contain text. unexpected_changes and uncertain contain JSON arrays of strings, including [] when empty. Do not nest a card or review object inside any parameter.
Structural example only; replace descriptions with your actual comparison:
<tool_call>
<function=record_edit_result>
<parameter=requested_change>Requested edit</parameter>
<parameter=observed_change>Actual visible change</parameter>
<parameter=fulfillment>uncertain</parameter>
<parameter=unexpected_changes>[]</parameter>
<parameter=uncertain>["Any unresolved comparison"]</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

content.text: {"executed_editing_prompt":"Replace the video's scene with the environment shown in the reference image, using the reference image to define the target environment. Keep the same person, hairstyle, hair color, outfit, expression, and action. Maintain the existing camera framing and movement, and light the person naturally within the new scene.","history_selection_status":"Already executed. Only compare editing requirements; historical appearance words are not observed facts.","original_user_request":"Using the provided source video, apply the following edit: I'd like to replace the video's scene with the environment shown in the reference image. Use the reference image to define the target environment. Keep the same person, hairstyle, hair color, outfit, expression, and action. Maintain the existing camera framing and movement, and light the person naturally within the new scene.","output_video_card":{"observed":{"action":"The character stands with her back to the camera, then raises one arm to her head and shifts her weight and legs in a slow dance-like pose.","camera":"Static medium-full shot from behind the character at a slight low angle.","clothing":"A blue and white patterned one-piece romper with cut-out shoulders and matching arm bands, plus red flat shoes.","hair_color":"White.","hairstyle":"Short, spiky white hair.","identity":"A 3D-rendered female character with a slim build and tanned skin, shown from behind.","scene":"A futuristic city plaza with a wet reflective floor, a large glass building with pink columns, and a glowing green circular ring display in the background."},"uncertain":[]}}

arguments.observed_change: The background changed from a sunset amusement park with a Ferris wheel and carousel to a futuristic glass building with pink columns, a glowing green circular ring, and a wet reflective plaza floor. The character remains in the same rear-facing pose and performs a similar slow dance-like movement, retaining white hair, the blue-and-white romper, and red shoes.
arguments.requested_change: Replace the amusement park scene with the futuristic city plaza from the reference, while preserving the same person, hairstyle, hair color, outfit, expression, action, camera framing, and natural lighting.
uncertain: Whether the character's expression was fully preserved, since she is mostly shown from behind
unexpected_changes: The character's skin appears darker/more saturated in the output than in the source, likely due to the new scene lighting
